theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ N ∩ U → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → 0 < δ₁ → 0 < δ₂ → closedBall x (δ₁ + δ₂) ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u (ball 0 δ₁) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, (∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u v‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖u v‖ < δ₂ / 2 ∧ x + ι v + u v ∈ N ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), ξN (x + ι v + u v) α * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (n + 1) => inner ℝ (ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (ι (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))) = α (fun i => ι (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) + fderiv ℝ u v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) → (∀ (v : Euclid (n + 1)) (h : Euclid P), ‖v‖ < δ₁ → ‖h‖ < δ₂ → (∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) h = 0) → x + ι v + h ∈ N → h = u v) → MeasurableSet (ball 0 δ₁ ∩ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) ⁻¹' E) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Euclid (n + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ ball 0 δ₁ → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → (∀ y, ‖φ y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in ball 0 δ₁ ∩ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) ⁻¹' E, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) ≤ C
